implementation_notes: The supplier publishes a Kotlin module or an OpenAPI contract; consumers depend on the generated client and pin its version. Use WireMock or MockWebServer stubs generated from the contract so consumer tests are independent of the supplier's availability.
idiom_name: generated client + WireMock stubs from the negotiated contract
pitfalls: Consumer tests depending on the supplier's live environment
Treating a negotiated field as optional in one consumer and required in another
